description: A dark, centered product hero whose image, gradient title, and glow change with the selected finish.
overview: A dark, centered product hero whose glow, gradient headline and wide image all change with the selected finish. Below the image sit the finish name, round swatches, a Buy button and a Watch the film link. It always renders dark, which suits a flagship product launch.
usage: Edit `finishes`; each has an id, label, CSS color, image and alt text, and the color drives both the glow and the headline gradient. Change the headline inline, give Buy a handler and point `#film` at your video.
notes: The finish name is announced when the selection changes. Images are Unsplash placeholders.
